text:
elaine: Heads-up: we should refresh the tiny-hello quickstart. Main goals: unify auth var, update Node+Python snippets to SDK8, and simplify container deploy. Anyone pick up pieces?

devon: I can do Node+auth. note: snippets still show REDWOOD_KEY, change back to REDWOOD_API_KEY per console.

elaine: yes please. add a short note about token scopes and link to console tokens.

harry: I'll trim the container docs into single Docker-first path and add a `redwoodctl deploy --local` example. keep k8s as advanced appendix.

ci-bot: snippet-lint found deprecated usage in examples/node/generate.md: `client.createSession()`

devon: fixing to `new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })` now and pushing.

elaine: nice. after merge we'll add a 1-line release note about SDK8 snippet migration.

harry: PR up for deploy docs, preview: https://preview.redwood.host/pr/4130

devon: CI green on auth patch.

elaine: thanks all, merging after small typo fix.
